Explanation:  
The Ground Truth Answer identifies the senator elected in Maryland in 2007 as Ben Cardin, and compares his service (20 years) in the Maryland House of Delegates with that of his uncle, Maurice Cardin (15 years), correctly specifying a 5-year difference.

The Predicted Answer incorrectly identifies the individuals: it uses George Della Jr. and George Della Sr., neither of whom are mentioned in the Ground Truth nor is either one the senator elected in 2007. It provides different years of service and calculates a 4-year difference between the Della family members. The essential facts and answer from the Ground Truth (identities, years of service, the 5-year difference) are entirely absent from the Predicted Answer.

Decision: FALSE
